notes: LI: 1 eligible with a CHF price: Sparissimo Food (new, Swiss, Pfäffikon SZ; nearest_local). Its Liechtenstein evidence is a Liechtenstein restaurant's ordering page on the vendor's own subdomain (anatolia.sparissimofood.com: 'in Nendeln, Liechtenstein', 'Zur Abholung oder Lieferung', 'Bereitgestellt von: ClickandFood'); the vendor's own pages never name Liechtenstein. Prices: blog.sparissimofood.com (updated 1 Oct 2026) gives Starter CHF 49/Monat + 8% Provision, Business 79 + 5%, Professional 148 + 5%, while the homepage shows a 0 CHF freemium entry with 5–8 % per order — pages disagree. Sparissimo also has a UK hotline and a Stockport entity, so it may count as a European multi-country tool (agent 1's catch-all) — I read it because the coordinator asked me to check Swiss tools for LI. No food-truck tool found for LI; no Liechtenstein-based ordering company found. Baldegger+Sortec (Swiss dealer whose AGBs deliver to CH and LI) resells the gastronovi ordering module at CHF 69 a month — recorded not_relevant as a reseller (gastronovi itself, German, not opened). Swiss tools seen in search with CHF prices but no Liechtenstein mention found by a site search: Zelloo, Lieferio, Bestell.org, DishButler, ordermood, GastroBoom (not opened). Round 1 already found no LI mention on Pikit, Yoveletta, Ordero, Rent-a-Shop, SwissPOS. FoxiFood's country-terms page does NOT list Liechtenstein (Switzerland only). Owned elsewhere, not fetched: Lightspeed (agent 3; ch-de pages in search), SumUp (agent 1; round 1 saw LI in a script-rendered help page).
